name: Bent-Over Row
common_faults: excessive torso movement (turning it into a hip-hinge swing)
hips too high reducing horizontal pull angle

substitutions.note: unilateral; removes axial demand; better scapular ROM
seated; no spinal load; constant cable tension

contraindications: acute low-back injury during bent-over loading
resistance_profile: hardest at the start of the pull (elbows farthest from torso); decreases at full retraction

provenance.notes: Spinal erectors work isometrically to maintain hinge position. Pendlay variant starts from floor each rep (reduces momentum). SFR heuristic.
